data.coverage: M≥1 earthquakes in Kansas and the immediate border region, 2010-01-01 through 2026-11-16 UTC
limits: The bounding box includes neighboring states. Detection and magnitude thresholds vary over time and space; missing small events are not evidence of no seismicity.
Magnitude types differ; counts and spatial correlation do not establish cause. Depth is the source estimate, not a measured subsurface structure.
This catalog snapshot is not real time and is not a hazard prediction. USGS can revise reviewed and automatic events.
